description: List the folder + file children of a Files surface (kind='files'). Folders sorted first by position then name; files sorted by name. Returns folders[], files[] with cuids agents can pass to `get_file` / `delete_file`. `parent_folder_id` defaults to null (= root of the surface); pass a folder id to descend into a sub-folder.

parent_folder_id.description: Folder id to descend into. Omit (or pass null) for the surface root.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts either the bare slug or the org-prefixed form ('my-org/my-workspace') as shown in the dashboard URL.

surface_slug.description: Files-kind surface slug within the workspace. Use list_surfaces to enumerate; the Files surface kind is 'files'.

name: list_files
